settings.heading: Configure your print settings

paper.title: Paper format

subsequent_rounds.title: Subsequent rounds
subsequent_rounds.prefilled_desc: Print scorecards for all qualifiers (requires WCA Live results)
subsequent_rounds.blanks_desc: Print blank name slots - fill in by hand at the competition

check_mode.title: Cover cards
check_mode.hint: Where the delegate and scoretaker checklist card is printed.
check_mode.per_group_desc: One checklist card in front of every group's scorecards (default).
check_mode.per_round_desc: One checklist card per event round instead of per group - fewer cards to print.

double_check.title: Scramble double-checking
double_check.hint: Adds a second scrambler-signature column so scrambles can be independently double-checked.
double_check.ranking_tooltip: Regulation 11i only owes a replacement attempt for a mis-scramble when the result is a regional record, a personal record in the world top 50, or a championship final scrambled by two scramblers.
double_check.ranking_hint: Matched against each competitor's personal bests, single or average. Their scrambles are double-checked in every round.
double_check.overrides_hint: Upload a CSV file - one line per competitor: WCAID,event1,event2 (e.g. 2015FOOB01,333,444). Their scrambles for those events are double-checked in every round.

wca_live.system_hint: Detected from the competition's scoretaking setting. Decides where the name tag QR codes point.
wca_live.mode_wca_live_desc: live.worldcubeassociation.org, the separate WCA Live site.
wca_live.mode_ilr_desc: Live results on the WCA website itself. No ID needed.
wca_live.title: WCA Live ID
wca_live.not_found: Not found on WCA Live yet - enter manually if needed
wca_live.hint: Numeric competition ID from WCA Live. Used to generate competitor-specific QR codes on name tags.
wca_live.hide_label: Hide the WCA Live line on blank scorecards
wca_live.hide_desc: Blank and extra scorecards drop the empty "WCA Live:" label. Cards with a competitor keep their ID.

logo.title: Competition logo
logo.hint: Appears in the top-left corner of each scorecard. PNG or SVG recommended.
logo.default_desc: Used in the top-left corner of each scorecard alongside the competition name when no custom logo is uploaded.
logo.use_default_hint: Recommended for Canadian competitions. Disable for competitions outside Canada.
logo.show_comp_name_label: Show the competition name on scorecards
logo.show_comp_name_desc: Printed above the competitor's name, for logos that don't include it.

nametag.title: Name tag layout
nametag.staff_desc: Delegates, organizers and volunteers who aren't competing get a tag with the QR codes on both sides.
nametag.logo_hidden_desc: Logo not shown on name tags
nametag.logo_with_name_desc: Small logo beside the competition name at the top of each panel
nametag.logo_only_desc: Logo replaces the competition name text - QR codes are slightly smaller to compensate
nametag.qr_back_only_desc: Front = group assignments, back = QR codes
nametag.qr_both_sides_desc: QR codes on both front and back - useful when logo takes space

advanced.merge_rounds_desc: Puts Round 1, Round 2, semifinals and finals in a single scorecard PDF. On very large competitions this file can be slow to generate and may fail on computers with little memory.
advanced.merge_rounds_stage_split: Not available while scorecards are split per stage.
advanced.stage_split_desc: Splits each round into its own PDF per stage, so every stage can be printed on a different paper colour. Only rounds that actually run across several stages are split.
advanced.custom_events_hint: Print 4 blank scorecards for side events or bonus puzzles not listed in the WCIF. Group and round fields will be left blank.
advanced.icon_hint: Icon - click a WCA icon or upload your own
advanced.csv_hint: One competitor per line: Name or Name,WCAID. Prints one named scorecard per row (plus blanks to fill the last page) instead of 4 blank cards. Lines starting with # are ignored.
advanced.final_stations_hint: A one-group final's blank scorecards get station numbers when it fits the stations. Type the station count to check it.
advanced.final_stations_detected: A one-group final's blank scorecards get station numbers when it fits the {{count}} stations found in the WCIF. Type a number to override it.

guide.title: How to print and cut

scorecards.callout: The scorecards come out already sorted. Cut them, keep the piles as they are, and you never have to sort anything by hand.

steps.print: Print the scorecard PDF single-sided, in page order. Don't shuffle the pages.
steps.cut: Cut every sheet into 4 along the cut lines, and keep the pieces separated by position: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Each of those four piles is already in the right order.
steps.stack: Put the top-left pile on the top-right one, then the bottom-left, then the bottom-right. That single deck holds every group of every round, in schedule order.
steps.covers: A cover card marks the start of each group, so you can take each group off the top of the deck as the round runs.

scorecards.a6_callout: The scorecards come out one per page, already sorted. No cutting needed.

guide.schedule: Schedule tracker: prints as-is, one page per day. Post it at the stage or hand it to the run team.
guide.checking: Round checklist: prints as-is, one table per day. Tick each round off as its scorecards come back in.
guide.group_overview: Group overview: prints as-is, one block per group. Post it at the stage so everyone can find their group, station and staff duty.
guide.nametags: Name tags: four people per page, front and back side by side. Cut out each pair and fold it down the middle before sliding it into a badge holder.
guide.first_timers: First-timer slips: the slips flow down the page. Cut between them and give each one to the delegate to sign after that newcomer's first solve.

scope.heading: What to generate
scope.intro: This competition already has groups for a round after Round 1. Choose what to print - you can adjust everything else on the next screen.
scope.intro_pre: Choose which documents to include. You can configure all options on the next screen.
scope.presets_hint: Optional. Presets pre-select the options a region usually prints - you can still change anything.
scope.needs_document: Pick at least one document to print.

latest.label: Latest round only
latest.desc: Print only the most recent round that has groups. Best during a competition.

everything.label: Everything
everything.desc: Print all rounds (and name tags, schedule, etc.), using assigned groups where available.

selected.label: Select rounds
selected.desc: Choose exactly which event rounds to print.

warnings.no_groups: No groups have been assigned for this competition yet, so scorecard counts show 0. Assign groups first (in Groupifier or on the WCA website), then come back here. You can still generate the schedule tracker and name tags in the meantime.
warnings.stage_split_prefilled: Round 2 is prefilled with the competitors from Round 1, who are not on a stage yet, so it stays one PDF. The other rounds are still split per stage.
warnings.merge_rounds_large: All rounds are merged into one very large scorecard PDF. Generating it can be slow and may fail on this computer. If it does, turn on splitting below.
warnings.ots_intro: This competition accepts on-the-spot registrations. People registered on the day are not in the WCIF, so a few things need fixing by hand:
warnings.ots_blanks: Use the blank name tags, first-timer slips and scorecards (one page each) for them.
warnings.ots_ids: Add each of them on the WCA website (and in WCA Live) before entering results: their scorecards have no ID until then.
warnings.ots_groups: Write their group on their scorecards and name tag. Group sizes, cover cards, the Group Overview and the Round Checklist do not count them.
warnings.ots_round2: Prefilled Round 2 scorecards only list registered competitors: use the extra scorecards for anyone added on the day.

about.title: About {{app}}
about.intro: {{app}} generates print-ready PDFs for a WCA competition: scorecards, name tags, a schedule tracker, and optional first-timer slips. Everything is laid out for printing and cutting.
about.wcif_body: Every WCA competition's data (events, schedule, and registered competitors) lives on the WCA website in a format called the WCIF. Group assignments are added upstream, usually with a tool like Groupifier.
about.workflow_body: This is the last step before printing. Once groups have been assigned, it reads the competition's WCIF and turns it into the documents you print and cut for the day of the competition.
about.privacy_body: The PDFs are built in your browser and your competition's data is never uploaded. When you generate, the tool sends an anonymous record of the competition id, how big the competition is, and which settings you chose, so we can see where it is being used and what to improve. It never sends your name, your WCA account, or any competitor's details.
about.privacy_optout: Don't send anonymous usage statistics from this browser
about.feedback_title: Found a bug or have feedback?
about.feedback_body: Report an issue on GitHub, or email the software team.
